title: Eventual Consistency and Sessions
description:
**SITUATION:**

You are still on the **Fleetline** dispatch team.

**What the dispatch service is.** Dispatch is Fleetline's backend for trips. It is not the map, not payments, and not the driver chat. It is the service that **owns trip state**: who requested the ride, which driver was matched, and what step the trip is on right now.

Driver location is **eventually** consistent: replicas converge when updates stop. After a tunnel and reconnect, the driver also wants **read-your-writes** so they do not stare at their own stale pin.

**YOUR TASK:**

Implement Lab 4.3 (`TODO(4.3)`).

1. Eventual propagation of `UpdateLocation` across lab replicas with a convergence test.
2. A session token so reconnect reads land on a replica that has seen that session's writes (or waits until it has).
3. Without sessions, read-your-writes may fail; with sessions, it must not.

**SPEC:**

- Replicas converge when updates quiesce
- Session reads honor read-your-writes
- Ownership / Match stays off the eventual path
- Soft location only

> **Note:** Graded Submit for this lab is not live yet. Use **Run** in the editor when verify commands exist; otherwise read the brief and explore the starter. The harness lands next.

hints: Eventual: replicas converge when updates stop.
Session token sticks reads to a replica that saw the session's writes.
Without sessions, reconnect can violate read-your-writes.
Ownership stays out of the eventual path.
problemStatement.overview: Locations converge eventually; sessions give read-your-writes after reconnect.
problemStatement.brief: Propagate UpdateLocation to convergence and honor session reads.
